WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    scans.zoneref,
    sites.healtheval,
    AVG(CASE WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin > 0 
             THEN scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin 
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.healtheval
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  step1.zoneref,
  step1.healtheval,
  step1.avg_ratio,
  step1.record_count,
  step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg as difference
FROM step1, step2
WHERE step1.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL 
  AND step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
